method.value: Measure major-axis extent on Q_phi images; fit ellipses to ten brightness contours; take median parameters and standard deviations.

evidence.quote: We measured the extension of the disks directly on the $Q_\phi$ frames
Then, we fitted an ellipse to each brightness contour level to find the PA of the disk, using ten levels to average over the whole disk surface.
Finally, we computed the best-fit value as the median of each ellipse parameter among the ten levels, with the standard deviation as the uncertainty.

referee_caveats_inferred: The ALMA contribution is a literature comparison; this paper does not provide an independent ALMA reduction recipe.
Quoted MCMC intervals are conditional on the adopted opacity and axisymmetric density model.
Visual chain stability alone does not establish effective sample size or quantitative convergence.
The 42.4 mas synthetic-image convolution differs from the reported approximately 50–55 mas observed PSFs.
The SED mass conversion applies a factor of 100 to a mass fitted only for micron-sized dust.
Two disks establish consistency with subgroup evolution, rather than a causal environmental effect.
